headline.text: L2 FFS has been down since 11:50 fighting web tracking — top edge won't track back up as of *12:28*.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 1 completed a complex startup with multiple delays (QA inspection, caramel program, temper loss) and ramped from 36 to 62 rows per rack by mid-shift. Sollich 3 ran smoothly after a quick filter pin repair.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 had a brief belt damage stop (10 minutes) then ran cleanly through a changeover to FEA 12g. FFS fought web tracking faults all shift — ran from 08:46 to 10:59, down again at 11:50, still down at window close.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line's M3 belt shifted three times despite maintenance work. ML1 (Imperial) had a slow startup with chain alignment and sensor issues but is running. ML4 had demolding problems early shift, cleared by 08:18, but quality is flagging cream exposure on 2 bars per mold. MF Matrix is rejecting heavy and light bags with no maintenance response since 06:58.

notes.text: Sollich 1 is ramping speed per plan with Eaglestone — 5 rows per rack every 90 minutes.
Hyfoama ingredient usage is not being tracked in NetSuite; IMS team flagged at 11:10.
Truffle line switched chocolate from item 10226 to 10121 at 09:09 after depleting stock.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 temper loss after e-stop, riser pump fault
resolved.summary: Depositor continued when line stopped for accumulation; tech hit e-stop, lost temper, riser pump faulting at 10:40.
resolved.resolution: Partial reheat completed, Brian turned riser pump down from 2300 to 2100; line running at 12:39.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 separating table #2 belt stops when raised
resolved.summary: Belt runs in down position but stops when raised to align with enrober at 05:56.
resolved.resolution: Able to get the belt to run by 06:17 — "We were able to get the separating belt to run."

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Russell finex filter pin broke
resolved.summary: Pin for the enrober filter broke at start of shift, noticed during pre-op.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance informed and repair complete, no timeline given but reported as done.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 checkweigher sensor not working, line paused
resolved.summary: CW sensor malfunction at 10:24 caused line stop while Troy and Russ troubleshot.
resolved.resolution: Russ fixed sensor sensitivity and Troy increased CW belt speed to 72m/min; running by 10:39.

resolved.title: FFS web tracking sensor out of range at startup
resolved.summary: Web frame fault and sealing failure starting at 06:17; tracking sensor replaced Friday with incorrect settings.
resolved.resolution: Dave Ruff found sensor settings weren't set properly after Friday replacement; fold corrected and line running at 08:46.

resolved.title: ML2 long belt damage at startup
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 05:59 for damage on the long belt.
resolved.resolution: Back up at 06:09 — "Line is back up" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: Truffle tunnel 3 not turning on
resolved.summary: Cooling tunnel 3 would not power on at 04:23; air supply was turned off.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance opened panel with hex key and restored air; running at 05:14.

resolved.title: ML1 Imperial chain misaligned, unusual noise
resolved.summary: Operator heard unusual noise at startup; chain was misaligned and mold lifting on one side.
resolved.resolution: Nelson centered the chain at 06:22; slight lift remains but cleared to start and running by 06:44.

resolved.title: ML4 product not demolding, temper question
resolved.summary: Bars not releasing from molds at 07:23; temper readings being verified on external meter.
resolved.resolution: Product demolding and appearance improving by 08:03; good bars at TG by 08:18.

resolved.title: ML4 mold jam at preheating
resolved.summary: Mold stuck in preheating area 2 at 04:46, could not be removed manually.

resolved.title: ML4 gondola belt chocolate jam, 30-minute stop
resolved.summary: Chocolate stuck in gondola exit belt and formed a ball; maintenance removed roller to clean at 11:19.
resolved.resolution: Roller cleaned and reinstalled; line restarted after 30 minutes at 11:31.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 screw found in MM9 pouch
needs_attention.summary: Foreign object (screw) discovered in Matrix 9 pouch at 09:14.
needs_attention.status: Single find reported; no follow-up on source or corrective action in thread.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 X-ray false positives from belt
needs_attention.summary: Ishida X-ray hitting on the belt itself, not product; rejecting good pouches starting at 10:42.
needs_attention.status: Troy wiped top of belt at 11:08; Jorel suggested checking underside; no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 MM10 missing pouch opening fingers
needs_attention.summary: Matrix 10 is missing its pouch opening fingers; borrowed one set from MM9 to continue at 08:50.
needs_attention.status: Workaround in place using MM9 parts; original fingers not located.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 one caramel deposit removed, running short
needs_attention.summary: One deposit not working correctly at 09:31; piston removed to avoid downtime.
needs_attention.status: Running with deposit removed; no repair timeline posted.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 heavy cream valve gasket leaking
needs_attention.summary: Kitchen 2 heavy cream valve gasket leaking at 09:58; maintenance needed to replace.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called for gasket replacement; no follow-up on completion.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 water leak in combat boiler pipe
needs_attention.summary: Water leaking from pipe leading to combat boiler at 11:31; needs tightening.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance requested to tighten; no confirmation of repair posted.

needs_attention.title: FFS web tracking issue, line down since 11:50
needs_attention.summary: Film tracking working but top edge too far down and will not track back up; line stopped at 11:50 after earlier sensor swap at 10:59.
needs_attention.status: Collar removed, cleaned and lubed at 12:13; still down with top edge issue as of 12:28.

needs_attention.title: Truffle M3 belt keeps shifting, recurring issue
needs_attention.summary: Belt shifted at 07:03, again at 08:06, 08:22, 08:52, and 10:22 despite maintenance adjustments each time.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called again at 10:22 after fourth shift; no update after that point.

needs_attention.title: Truffle aligner not working properly
needs_attention.summary: Aligner malfunction flagged at 06:30 with maintenance tagged.
needs_attention.status: No follow-up or resolution in the thread.

needs_attention.title: MFM throwing heavy and light bags, no maintenance response
needs_attention.summary: Multihead filler rejecting out-of-spec bags since 06:58; maintenance called but has not arrived as of 07:18.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 06:58; still no response at 07:18, no further updates in thread.

needs_attention.title: ML4 cream exposure on 2 bars per mold
needs_attention.summary: Bars showing cream exposure on the side; operator adjusting, coworker removing affected bars — 2 out of 30 bars per mold impacted.
needs_attention.status: Operator making adjustments at 11:46; manual removal of bad bars continues.

needs_attention.title: ML1 Sweco rubber chute torn
needs_attention.summary: Inspection found the Sweco rubber chute is torn at 05:21.
needs_attention.status: Reported during inspection; no repair or follow-up mentioned.
